pages.title: Open the Menu
pages.text: Press B (default) to open the physical Accessories menu: Amulet, Ring, Ring, and Belt, in that order. Right-click an accessory to place it in the first empty matching slot; this does not swap.

pages.title: Move Gear
pages.text: Use normal clicks or shift-click to move items between the four slots and your inventory. Right-click equip fails when the matching slot or both ring slots are full.

pages.title: Bind a Ring
pages.text: A Ring of Binding comes from four pedestals: Diamond Block (50,000 Blue), Obsidian (50,000 White), Gold Block (50,000 Yellow), and Redstone Block (50,000 Red). See $(l:aura:fairy_roles)Fairy Charms$(/l).
